observations: Black office chair with a mesh backrest.
The backrest features a distinctive central spine with a leaf-like support structure.
A circular logo is embossed on the rear of the seat base, but the text/symbol is illegible.
The photo shows only the rear view of the chair.
Watermark 'STARDOM OF GRACE NIG LTD' and 'POSTED ON Jiji' are present.

claims.evidence: Visual inspection of the back cannot confirm lumbar support effectiveness or comfort.
A still photo cannot demonstrate rotation.
Adjustment levers and the gas lift mechanism are not clearly visible or demonstrated.

risks.proof: Photo of the front of the chair showing the seat pan and the front of the backrest.
risks.if_unproven: as having a torn or heavily stained seat and damaged mesh

risks.proof: Video showing the chair rotating 360 degrees and the height being adjusted.
Video showing the chair tilting back and locking in place.

proof_requests: Photo of the front of the chair to see the seat and backrest condition.
Video showing the swivel, height adjustment, and tilt functions working.
Close-up photo of the logo on the back and any labels under the seat to identify the brand.
response.reason: Only the rear of the chair is visible. The condition of the seat and the front of the backrest, which are the primary contact surfaces, is unknown. Functional components like the gas lift and tilt mechanism cannot be verified from a single static image.
